values.description: Your Supabase project URL (e.g., https://abcdefghijklmnop.supabase.co)
Your Supabase anonymous/public key (found in Supabase dashboard > Settings > API)
Your Supabase user email for authentication
Your Supabase user password for authentication
JWT token - automatically populated by pre-request script
Token expiry timestamp - automatically populated by pre-request script
Organization UUID - Automatically populated by pre-request script from GET /api/users/me
Clinic UUID - Automatically populated by pre-request script from GET /api/users/me
Client UUID - Get this from the Get All Clients response
User UUID - Automatically populated by pre-request script from GET /api/users/me
Client Note UUID - Automatically populated from Get Client Notes response (if notes exist)
Species UUID - Automatically populated from Get Species (Public) response (if species exist)
Pet UUID - Automatically populated from Get All Pets response (if pets exist)
Appointment UUID - Automatically populated from Get Appointments by Clinic response (if appointments exist)
SOAP Note UUID - Automatically populated from Create SOAP Note response. Used by Get SOAP Note by ID and Update SOAP Note endpoints.
Supabase Auth User ID - Automatically populated by pre-request script from JWT token (sub field)
Array of State UUIDs (JSON string) - Automatically populated from Get States response
Array of User UUIDs (JSON string) - Automatically populated from Get All Users response
Target User UUID - Automatically populated from Get User by ID response. Used by Restore User and Permanent Delete User endpoints.
Clinic Service UUID - Automatically populated from Get Clinic Services response (if services exist). Used by Update Clinic Service endpoint.
Invoice UUID - Automatically populated from Get All Invoices response (if invoices exist). Used by Get Invoice by ID endpoint.
Invoice Item UUID - Automatically populated from Get Invoice by ID response (from added_invoice_items array, if items exist). Used by Get Invoice Item by ID endpoint.
